name: Godliness
overview: Godliness involves a life set apart from ungodliness, characterized by walking humbly with God and pursuing His righteousness above all else, as shown in Psalms 1:1, Micah 6:8, and Matthew 6:33. It calls believers to offer themselves as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God, demonstrating a practical devotion rooted in faith (Romans 12:1). The danger of ungodliness is clear in Jude 1:4, warning against those who deny Christ and twist God's grace, while Jude 1:20 encourages believers to build themselves up in faith through prayer, reinforcing a life marked by godliness and spiritual growth.
